column1: # American -> British vocabulary, one per line: american<TAB>british.
# Whole words or phrases; longer phrases are applied first. Matching ignores case
# and keeps the original's capitalisation. Only swaps whose British word has no
# other meaning in the game are listed (no torch, vest, jumper, tin, rubber, flat,
# pavement, silencer, paraffin, chemist, spirits, biscuit, boot or bonnet).
